entries.change: Dropped 'driven mostly by food' (it was now credited to Morales, whose 73.6% sentence does not say it) and dropped Thorp's 1979 figure of 70%.
entries.why: Morales p.~126: 'La inflación alcanzó el 73.6%, doblando prácticamente el índice de 1977', with no mention of food. Thorp Table 13 does list 70 for 1979, but the paper was written in 1979 and its text gives the April 1979 forecast as 'almost 60 percent', so 70 is not a final yearly figure. Checked: Thorp Table 13 38.1/74 (source Banco Central); BFI Table 3 38.0/58.1/67.7, note 'Lima consumer price index collected by the national statistics agency (INEI)'.
